{{*}} [[Ring of dueling]] ([[Emir's Arena]]) |music = * [[Al Kharid (music track)|Al Kharid]] * [[Arabian]] * [[Arabian 2]] |map = {{Map|name=Al Kharid|x=3290|y=3185|height=300|width=300|zoom=2}} |type = settlement |leagueRegion = Desert }} '''Al Kharid''' is a large city in the north of the [[Kharidian Desert]], and the only desert city open to [[Free-to-play|non-members]]. Players in the city do not suffer from the [[Desert heat|desert effect]]. Al Kharid is popular among free-to-play players because it contains one of the closest [[Al Kharid bank|banks]] to a [[range]] and to a furnace, two reasonably close [[fishing spots]], and a [[tanner]], [[Ellis]]. Also popular is the nearby [[Al Kharid mine|mining site]], which contains almost all ores up to and including [[Adamantite ore|adamant]].
